about: Ask a notary to cancel a contract or deed that was previously notarised.
note: Requirements read from the official MOJ service page on the checked date. MOJ fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. The page prints the fee without a currency, AED assumed. Cancellation of contracts and deeds. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The contract or deed must have been notarised earlier
documents: Proof of each party's capacity and authority
Agency document if a party acts through an agent
The original contract or deed to be cancelled
channels: eNotary portal (enotary.moj.gov.ae), sign in with UAE PASS
